Parses the organization response, enforces exact-one cardinality, and returns the selected Moid.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Organization resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    expectedName = sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Organization lookup must return exactly one result; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif rows[0].get("Name") != expectedName:
        status = "identity-mismatch"
        statusCode = 409
        message = "Organization response does not preserve the exact requested Name."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organizationMoid = str(rows[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The exact organization result has no Moid.")
        resultJson = json.dumps({"organization": rows[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys
status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="ok",200,"Source and target selected","{}",False
sourceMoid=sourceItemUrl=collisionUrl="";targetVersion=selectedSourceVersion=0
try:
 body=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);name=sys.argv[2];selection=sys.argv[3];sourceVersion=int(sys.argv[4]);requestedNew=int(sys.argv[5]);organizationMoid=sys.argv[6]
 rows=body.get("Results") if isinstance(body,dict) else None;count=body.get("Count") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
 if not isinstance(rows,list) or isinstance(count,bool) or not isinstance(count,int) or count<0: raise ValueError("Family response must contain a non-negative integer Count and Results array.")
 if count>1000: status,statusCode,message="paging-required",422,"More than 1000 family versions require internal paging; this export fails closed before mutation.";exact=[];versions=[];chosen=[]
 elif count!=len(rows): status,statusCode,message="incomplete-page",422,"Family Results are incomplete relative to Count; this export fails closed before mutation.";exact=[];versions=[];chosen=[]
 else:
  exact=[row for row in rows if row.get("Name")==name and isinstance(row.get("Organization"),dict) and row["Organization"].get("Moid")==organizationMoid]
  versions=[int(row.get("Version",0)) for row in exact]
 if status=="ok" and len(exact)!=len(rows): status,statusCode,message="identity-mismatch",409,"Family response contains an identity outside the exact requested filter.";chosen=[]
 elif status=="ok" and len(versions)!=len(set(versions)): status,statusCode,message="conflict",409,"Family contains duplicate version identities.";chosen=[]
 elif status=="ok" and selection=="Preferred": chosen=[row for row in exact if row.get("PreferredVersion") is True]
 elif status=="ok" and selection=="Specific": chosen=[row for row in exact if int(row.get("Version",0))==sourceVersion]
 elif status=="ok": chosen=[] if not exact else [max(exact,key=lambda row:int(row.get("Version",0)))]
 if status=="ok" and len(chosen)!=1: status,statusCode,message=("not-found",404,"Source selector returned no definition.") if len(chosen)==0 else ("conflict",409,"Source selector returned multiple definitions.")
 if status=="ok":
  sourceMoid=str(chosen[0].get("Moid") or "");selectedSourceVersion=int(chosen[0].get("Version",0));targetVersion=requestedNew if requestedNew>0 else max(versions)+1
  if not sourceMoid or selectedSourceVersion<1 or targetVersion<1: raise ValueError("Selected source or computed target version is invalid.")
  sourceItemUrl="/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions/"+sourceMoid
  escapedName=name.replace("'","''");escapedRef=name.replace(" ","_").replace("-","_").replace("'","''")
  collisionUrl="/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions?$filter=Organization.Moid eq '%s' and Version eq %d and (Name eq '%s' or RefName eq '%s')&$select=Moid,Name,Version,RefName&$top=1"%(organizationMoid,targetVersion,escapedName,escapedRef)
  resultJson=json.dumps({"source":chosen[0],"targetVersion":targetVersion},separators=(",",":"))
 else: resultJson=json.dumps({"error":message,"familyVersionCount":len(exact)},separators=(",",":"))
 ready=True
except Exception as exc: status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="malformed",502,str(exc),json.dumps({"error":str(exc)},separators=(",",":")),True

properties.description: Maps every normalized selector to exactly one accessible local or shared catalog and builds one combined blueprint query.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Catalog selectors resolved", "{}", False
resolvedConfigsJson = "[]"
blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'"
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    configs = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not isinstance(configs, list):
        raise ValueError("Catalog response or normalized configuration has the wrong shape.")
    resolved = []
    for config in configs:
        if config["CatalogSelectorType"] == "Moid":
            matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("Moid") == config["CatalogMoid"]]
        else:
            matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("Name") == config["CatalogName"]]
        eligible = []
        for row in matches:
            relation = row.get("Organization")
            relatedMoid = relation.get("Moid") if isinstance(relation, dict) else ""
            if not relatedMoid or relatedMoid == organizationMoid:
                eligible.append(row)
        if len(eligible) != 1:
            status = "not-found" if len(eligible) == 0 else "conflict"
            statusCode = 404 if len(eligible) == 0 else 409
            message = "Each catalog selector must resolve exactly one accessible catalog; selector for %s returned %d. Use CatalogMoid for ambiguous shared/local names." % (config["Name"], len(eligible))
            break
        copy = dict(config)
        copy["ResolvedCatalogMoid"] = eligible[0]["Moid"]
        resolved.append(copy)
    if status == "ok":
        clauses = []
        for config in resolved:
            clause = "Catalog.Moid eq '%s' and Name eq '%s'" % (config["ResolvedCatalogMoid"], config["BlueprintName"].replace("'", "''"))
            clause += " and DefaultVersion eq true" if config["VersionSelection"] == "Default" else " and Version eq %d" % config["Version"]
            clauses.append("(" + clause + ")")
        blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=" + (" or ".join(clauses) if clauses else "Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'")
        resolvedConfigsJson = json.dumps(resolved, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"resolvedCatalogCount": len(resolved)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "No collision found", "{}", False
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Collision response does not contain a Results array.")
    if rows:
        status, statusCode = "conflict", 409
        message = "The proposed identity already exists; collision result count is %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        resultJson = json.dumps({"collisionCount": 0, "raceWindow": "A concurrent create can still win after this preflight."}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

import json

 ready=True
except Exception as exc: status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="malformed",502,str(exc),json.dumps({"error":str(exc)},separators=(",",":")),True

properties.description: Polls the exact definition with both an absolute deadline and a hard iteration ceiling.
Creates one absolute deadline from the validated timeout; polling also has a hard 360-attempt ceiling.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Polling initialized", "{}", False
deadlineEpoch = ""
if timeout < 30 or timeout > 3600:
    status, statusCode, message = "invalid", 400, "Wait Timeout Seconds must be from 30 through 3600."
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    deadlineEpoch = str(time.time() + timeout)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"timeoutSeconds": timeout, "maximumAttempts": 360}, separators=(",", ":"))
ready = True

properties.description: Sleeps at most ten seconds and never past the absolute deadline before the current bounded item read.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
attempt = int(sys.argv[2])
remaining = deadline - time.time()
timedOut = remaining <= 0
if not timedOut:
    time.sleep(min(10.0, remaining))
    timedOut = deadline - time.time() <= 0
status, statusCode, message, ready = "ok", 200, "Bounded poll delay completed", True
resultJson = json.dumps({"attempt": attempt, "timedOut": timedOut}, separators=(",", ":"))

Creates one new version of an existing Cisco Unified Edge workload definition by copying one exact preferred, latest, or specific source and applying controlled Description or complete Blueprint Configuration overrides. Only writable fields are copied; Moid, RefName, Status, summaries, metadata, validation state, and preferred-version state are omitted. New-version and generated-RefName collisions are checked before POST but remain subject to a concurrent-create race. Setting the new version preferred is blocked with 422 before mutation because automatic previous-preferred clearing and rollback behavior still require live-tenant proof.
